title: Traffic Signal - Lights Out All Directions
description: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report a traffic signal where signal lights are all out/completely dark in all directions. *** Do not use this for flashing signal lights, street lights, or single color bulb outage *** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 1 business day.

observedQuestions.question: When did you notice the problem?
If there are other signals in the area, are those completely dark in all directions as well?
Based on what you see, is there an obvious cause for the signal outage?
Do you see any temporary stop signs at the intersection?
Is this a mid-block pedestrian signal?
Would you like to be contacted?
options: Yes - prior to work being completed
Yes - once the work is completed

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about a traffic signal completely dark in all directions.
actions.why: For a traffic signal whose lights are completely out in every direction. The public 311 page has an online request form that asks when the outage was noticed, whether nearby signals are also dark, an apparent cause, temporary stop signs, and whether it is a mid-block pedestrian signal.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Traffic Signal - Lights Out All Directions" requests does not apply to flashing signal lights, street lights, or a single-color bulb outage.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "Traffic Signal - Lights Out All Directions"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "Traffic Signal - Lights Out All Directions"

actions.tagline: Call Dallas 311 by phone about a signal completely dark in all directions.
actions.why: For a traffic signal whose lights are completely out in all directions. The description for "Traffic Signal - Lights Out All Directions" requests on the Dallas 311 website says the request must be dispatched and directs people to call 311.
actions.why_not: This call instruction is not for flashing signals, street lights, or a single-color bulb outage.
